gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype, WHO Grade 4 consistent with WHO CNS 2021 criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Ivonescimab: Participante will recived an infusion by vein

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent supratentorial Glioblastoma that has progressed following standard therapy; patients must have previously been treated with radiation with or without temozolomide.

role_evidence.quote: Treatment with Ivonescimab: Participants will be enrolled in either Phase 1 or Phase 2 depending on when they join the study.

source_quote.quote: Diagnosis of Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype, WHO Grade 4 consistent with WHO CNS 2021 criteria.

coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1/2 of ivonescimab; no PK or pharmacodynamic endpoints registered. Prior anti-VEGF/anti-PD-1 treatment is an exclusion criterion (not a biomarker).
